# lzo / lzo_compress_target

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `lzo_compress_target` ([source](source/lzo_compress_target.c), unmodified) over lzo (oberhumer.com/opensource/lzo/download/lzo-2.10.tar.gz release archive c0f89294).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, a round trip: For compressible input (compressed_len < size), lzo1x_decompress into size+1 bytes must return LZO_E_OK and produce exactly size bytes. ONLY THE LENGTH is compared: the decompressed content is never memcmp'd against the input, so a decoder that returned the right number of wrong bytes would pass.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against lzo from the release archive c0f89294.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- For compressible input (compressed_len < size), lzo1x_decompress into size+1 bytes must return LZO_E_OK and produce exactly size bytes. ONLY THE LENGTH is compared: the decompressed content is never memcmp'd against the input, so a decoder that returned the right number of wrong bytes would pass ([lines 97-100](source/lzo_compress_target.c#L97-L100)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch lzo` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
